mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the pulling threads was most worthwhile because the result connected the cell parts to the fibers' pulling action. The described two-pose illustration makes the change in filament overlap concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining water and mineral salts was straightforward preparation, though it established what the membrane would enclose.

surprise.text: The final description clarified that the repeating unit shortens as the filaments overlap further, while each filament stays the same length.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The visible parts and goals gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because I want to see how these working muscle fibers become tissue and contribute to movement. The described illustrations helped connect the parts to their jobs, though their visual clarity cannot yet be assessed.
